title: docs: add reasoning quickstart to text generation guide
author: xiaotian1171
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #13904

## Changes
- Adds a concise **Reasoning** section to the text-generation docs source.
- One `POST /v1/chat/completions` example and one `POST /text` example, both using the existing `reasoning_effort` parameter.
- Points readers to model metadata for checking reasoning support. No runtime changes, no generated docs touched.

## Test plan
- Docs build renders the new section with both examples.

gist.headline: A map for deeper thoughts
gist.blurb: The text-generation guide now has a small trail marker for reasoning models. Two copyable requests, one less expedition through parameter names.
gist.summary: Added a Reasoning section to the text-generation guide with POST /v1/chat/completions and POST /text examples using reasoning_effort, plus guidance for checking model metadata support.
gist.impact: Developers can now quickly enable reasoning_effort in either text API format and confirm which models support it before building.

A retro terminal displays model metadata beside sprouting code-plants, making the documentation addition feel like a clear path through deeper model thinking.
